activities.title: Stroll Mall Road & The Ridge
activities.description: Start the day with a leisurely walk along Mall Road, enjoy the colonial architecture, and soak up views from The Ridge. Free activity; light walking.

activities.title: Himachal Pradesh State Museum
activities.description: Explore the museum’s collection of regional art, artifacts, and history. Entry fee approx. INR 20 per person.

activities.title: Lunch at Café Sol (Mall Road)
activities.description: Enjoy a hearty Himachali‑influenced lunch with dishes like Chana Madra and Momos. Estimated cost INR 350 per person.

activities.title: Jakhu Temple Visit
activities.description: Take a short auto‑rickshaw ride (≈15 min) to Jakhu Temple, climb to the giant Hanuman statue and enjoy panoramic views. No entry fee.

activities.title: Tea & Snacks at Jakhu Café
activities.description: Warm up with tea/coffee and light snacks. Estimated cost INR 100 per person.

activities.title: Christ Church & Mall Road Shopping
activities.description: Return to Mall Road, visit the historic Christ Church (free) and browse local shops for souvenirs.

activities.title: Rashtrapati Niwas (Viceregal Lodge)
activities.description: Drive to the Viceregal Lodge, explore its gardens and museum. Entry fee approx. INR 30 per person.

activities.title: Return to Hotel / Evening Rest
activities.description: Head back to the hotel, unwind and reflect on the day.
